title: bug fix: shot accuracy above 100 percent
brief: Bug: the accuracy shown for a match can be more than 100%. Find where the accuracy is computed in src/game and fix it so that it is the percentage (rounded to a whole number) of the cells fired so far that were hits, and null when no cell has been fired yet. A single normal shot must keep giving the same numbers as before. Run the project's tests when you are done.
